messages:
maria: Alert: large late telemetry window hit for prod-eu (2026-03-22T01). Console shows replay preflight passed but enqueue fails with 429 quota. Anyone nearby?
ben: Which tenant? link?
maria: tenant=zephyr, replay id=RPL-20260322-eu-77. console: https://console.replays/zephyr/77 - preflight est=1.1M tokens but actual enqueue rejected.
ops-bot: replay-service: RPL-20260322-eu-77 -> enqueue failed: QuotaExceeded (tenant=zephyr, route=standard, tokens=1123456)
ravi: We've seen this when console preflight uses cached quota snapshot. Need a live quota check during enqueue.
sara: Also UX: console shows only one recommended route. We should show alternate routes with token deltas. I'll add UX ticket UX-1456.
ben: Short-term: ops can re-run via CLI with lower slot weight: `redwood replay run --id RPL-20260322-eu-77 --route economy --slot-weight 0.4`
maria: Doing that now. But note: economy variant in eu may not have warmed KV shards. If latency jumps, abort.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: oncall_replay started rerun at 2026-03-22T01:10Z
ops-bot: replay-service: RPL-20260322-eu-77 rerun -> queued (route=economy, slot_weight=0.4)
ravi: Longer term: propose API preflight endpoint that returns per-route est_tokens, slot_weight, kv_warm_hint. Console should call that and let ops choose. Ticket API-8902.
sara: Also create a dashboard alert for "replay_enqueue_429_rate" so we can catch systemic quota mismatches. DASH-312 filed.
ben: If rerun stalls, we might need temporary tenant bump + audit log: `tenant-alloc bump zephyr +6 --reason "late-replay emergency"` (ops only).
maria: Rerun progressed to 12% and looks healthy. Monitoring recompute-cost and aggregate freshness.
ops-bot: oncall_replay marked thread resolved at 2026-03-22T01:38Z
